title: Room 1046: The Man Who Vanished in Plain Sight

lines.text: In nineteen thirty-five, a stranger checked into Room ten forty-six.
He carried no bags and demanded an interior room with no windows.
The shades were drawn shut, leaving the room pitch black.
Whenever the maid arrived, he sat motionless in the dark.
He whispered for her to leave the door unlocked.
The next morning, the telephone was left off the hook.
Hotel staff unlocked the room to complete silence.
Inside, he had been tied up and brutally attacked.
Detectives begged him to name his attacker.
Ninety years later, the mystery of Room ten forty-six remains unsolved.
